config.recommended_runtime: CPU or T4 (no training; numpy + sklearn only)

deviations: tau_ref=8.0 is the headline (reference Phase 1 instantiated tau_m=8.0; paper text says 10); tau swept over [4.0, 8.0, 16.0]
LIF layer run batched across frames (same equations; equality-checked below)
features computed from cached spikes (replicates extract_features; equality-checked below)
spike5 / snap512 / snap2048 / welch512 feature sets are NEW variants (not in the reference)
theta_enc, M, LIF weight draw and tau_m swept; the reference used theta=0.04, M=64, weight seed 42, tau 8
condition 'random': NEW sweep/pulse generators + random NB frequency + random 512-pt snapshot position
seeds [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]: offset 0 == reference frames, offsets >0 are fresh frames (seed + 100000*k)
classifier accuracy only; anomaly-detector calibration not exercised here
